responsibility: Declares the Rust HIR type resolver and related generic-bound utilities. TypeCheckType is the visitor that maps HIR type syntax to TyTy nodes, TypeResolveGenericParam resolves generic parameters into ParamType objects, ResolveWhereClauseItem applies where-clause bounds to resolved types, and the generic-argument helper extracts HIR generic argument lists from path segments for subsequent substitution.
same_name_distinction: Declares the type-resolution interfaces—TypeCheckType, TypeResolveGenericParam, ResolveWhereClauseItem, and generic-argument extraction helpers—without the actual resolution algorithms. Those are implemented in rust-hir-type-check-type.cc.
